verdict.rationale: The SDK documents a dedicated streaming mode: `Runner.run_streamed()` returns a `RunResultStreaming`, calls the LLM in streaming mode and streams events as they arrive. The streaming guide says you can subscribe to run updates to show end users progress and partial responses, which covers real-time token output. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that tool-call and step events appear in the stream (only implied by 'updates of the agent run'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming to a UI.
